pages.title: Stellar Plasma
pages.text: The hot, ionised gas from a star's core, where hydrogen fuses into helium at fifteen million kelvin. It glows white and roils with magnetic field lines, and it wants to escape in every direction at once.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Harvesting a Pocket Universe in the Universe Forge, the first stars to form inside it gave up their core plasma. Cosmogenesis, and then I took the starlight.
